thread:
tess: FYI small surge of tiny GPU pods pending in apse1-c, warm nodes showing attach timeouts and immediate preempt churn.
sam: saw alert from ops-bot ~1m ago. pattern: 0.125GPU jobs stuck waiting attach, then preempted.
ops-bot: ALERT: scheduler.preempt_evictions_rate > 60/s apse1 for 2m.
jin: grabbing node logs now. any recent node-kernel or driver rollouts?
lee: we pushed a NIC firmware bump to warm pool in apse1 last night (auto-canary).
tess: that could be it. logs show `attach rpc timeout` and then `attach succeeded` after 90-180s.
sam: 90-180s attach kills tiny pods. plan: cordon affected warm nodes, rollback firmware on that nodepool, and mute eviction alert for 20m.
jin: cordoning nodes now and marking with taint `tiny-suspend=true:NoSchedule`.
ops-bot: CORDON: warm-apse1-[1..8] cordoned by jin. ALERT MUTE: preempt_evictions_rate apse1 20m.
lee: starting firmware rollback canary on 2 nodes. will monitor attach latency.
tess: also add scheduler side quick-fix: increase latebind timeout window for tiny pods from 3s -> 12s tomorrow if we see reoccurrence. low-risk but buys headroom.
sam: good. open ticket INFRA-4902 to track firmware vs attach and add runbook steps.
ops-bot: ROLLBACK: firmware rollback started on warm-apse1 canary nodes.
lee: canary results: attach latency down to ~4s after rollback; no evictions during test burst.
jin: propagating rollback to rest of warm pool.
tess: awesome. follow-ups: 1) gate future warm-pool firmware with tiny-pod attach perf tests, 2) add node-label `attach-fast=true` and scheduler preference for short lived jobs, 3) alert tuning for tiny-pod eviction patterns.
sam: assigning owners in INFRA-4902. thanks team. :thumbsup:
